question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

He says, "I am building a model ship in my spare time."

options.text: He says that he was building a model ship in his spare time.
He says that he is building a model ship in his spare time.
He said that he is building a model ship in his spare time.
He says that a model ship is being built by him in his spare time.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
